catalogInspection: Parameterized read-only pg_catalog queries;strict result decoding;W4 required subset matching;exact enum order,column properties and emitted unique constraints/backing-index validity.
transactionModel: Single pinned client in external rollback-on-rejection exclusive transaction;inspect all objects before first mutation;exact immutable SQL only;complete final catalog re-read;no partial-success commit.

authorization.FUTURE_REQUIRED: Explicit authorization bound to live plan digest,payload digest,target digest and authenticated migration principal;application-runtime actor rejected.

CONCURRENCY_RESIDUAL: No canonical lock helper exists in bounded provisioning. No DB lock protocol invented. Future apply is denied without a W8-authenticated adapter implementing withExclusiveTransaction,including exclusive concurrency and rollback-on-rejection. This phase supplies and tests the mechanism/interface,not the concrete DB connector or runtime guard.

receiptModel.PERSISTENCE: NONE;future caller owns receipt storage;no business/audit table invented

REPLAY_SAFETY: Matching baseline -> REPLAY_NOOP;0 mutations;VERIFY_ONLY. Any governed drift/precondition failure -> fail before mutation;no repair/coercion/duplicate tolerance.
